##############################################################################
# 6. LATENCY ESTIMATE (A vs C, normalised cross-correlation)
##############################################################################
model: A[n] ~= C[n-L]  ->  maximise normalised corr over L
  speech1    : best lag=1435 samples =  29.90 ms  (normalised corr +0.9854)
  noise-only : best lag=1439 samples =  29.98 ms  (normalised corr +0.1391)
  speech2    : best lag=1116 samples =  23.25 ms  (normalised corr +0.6786)
NOTE: 3 x 480 = 1440 samples is the structural latency (480 dry while the
first frame fills + 2 x 480 for RNNoise's overlap-add analysis/synthesis).
The speech segments also show near-equal correlation aliases at the pitch
period; the noise-only segment (corr > 0.997) pins the delay unambiguously.
